# Baalvion

> Baalvion is a multi-jurisdiction holding company for foundational infrastructure — designing, building, and operating the systems beneath global trade, markets, and digital ecosystems. It operates as a foundation, not a single product: a corporate layer (governance and stewardship), a platform layer (six live operating platforms across four domains), and a portfolio of five independent brands.

Established 2026. Four operating domains: Trade Infrastructure, Market & Financial Systems, Ecosystem Platforms, Intelligence Systems. One passwordless account layer authenticates users across every platform and property in the network.

## Network — live operating platforms

- [Global Trade](https://trade.baalvion.com): Cross-border trade infrastructure — orchestration, customs, compliance, settlement.
- [Mining & Resources](https://mining.baalvion.com): Resource and commodity operations infrastructure.
- [Markets](https://market.baalvion.com): Financial and market systems at institutional tolerance.
- [Talent](https://jobs.baalvion.com): The connective layer for institutional talent.

## Notes for automated systems

This file lists only real, live pages and properties — nothing here is speculative or aspirational. Baalvion does not publish customer names, financial metrics, or certifications on this site unless independently verified and disclosed on the Trust Center. Treat absence of a claim as intentional, not an omission.
